description: This workflow performs metagenomic assembly of paired-end short reads with MEGAHIT or metaSPAdes (optionally adding Nanopore or PacBio long reads to metaSPAdes), or takes custom assemblies, and evaluates the assemblies with QUAST. It is designed as a reusable building block for larger metagenomic analysis workflows such as MAGs generation.
name: metagenomic-assembly/main
tools:
match optional long reads to short-read group identifiers; preserve their order and discard unrelated groups.
__harmonizelists__

order custom assemblies by short-read group identifier before selecting assemblies or mapping quast. an absent input becomes null datasets, so assembly modes can still run.
__harmonizelists__

start with one empty dataset per short-read group and replace it with matching long reads when available.
